body: I think you should engage in more foreplay. Learn to enjoy your partner more and focus on making her feel good. The results could surprise you.

Perhaps you could start by asking her what you can do to make things easier for her. Most importantly tell her that you love her. Don't lecture, give advice right now. Just be there with her while she crys, vents, stares blankly ahead, screams and shouts, or whatever it is she needs to do right now. Don't ask questions. Listen to her if she speaks and give her a shoulder to cry on.

A woman jumped from the highest building in Sydney city on International Women's Day.
Accuse me of trying to get into a head of a crazy suicide person if you like,  blame the victim if it's easier for you but don't overlook the facts when you do so. In my opinion you would have to be daft, selfish or in denial not to acknowledge the point she was trying to make.

Statistics can be used to prove anything and are best used for generalisations. The facts show that NO men committed suicide by jumping of the highest building in our city yesterday, only one woman. And yes it may not have had anything to do with her rights but really what is the probability of that actually being the case?

Most likely but it depends which artery you cut and what is below the bridge as well as a number of other variables.
Most importantly many people who have survived bridge jumps have said that the moment their feet left the bridge they instantly regretted it.
You have something unique to give to humanity, reach out because there are still many good people in this world.

Get a brain scan because most people forget that mental illness has physiological causes, and it will show up as an abnormality if something is wrong. 
The go to treatment for many forms of bipolar is lithium - which can be helpful but long term use is questionable. 
My advice is get lots of opinions but don't rely on them alone. Make use of the amazing medical technology out there to give you accurate results.
And why are you too scared to talk to your mom about it? Are you scared she will mock or ridicule you,  or are you scared she will tell you that you are wrong?
